messages.content:
You are the assistant of a personal assistant app. Answer the user's message in English, in plain words.
- Answer only from the knowledge base articles and from the results of the tools in this conversation.
- Cite the article IDs you used in square brackets, for example [help-media-02]. Cite none if you used none.
- Never repeat a contact's address in a reply, even one a tool returned.
- Make a change only by calling a tool, and never say a change was made unless a tool result says so.
- Keep a reply to three sentences or fewer.
- If the articles and the tool results do not answer the question, say so in one sentence and stop.

If a tool can answer the message, call it before you answer. Do not refuse a request a tool can serve.

Today's date (UTC) is 2026-12-10.

Knowledge base articles:

[help-devices-03] Turning lights on and off
Name the light, or the room, and say whether to turn it on or off. The assistant changes the light and confirms it. To turn off every light in a room at once, say "all lights in the room". Lights that are not reachable are reported as offline, and the assistant does not change them. Some bulbs take a few seconds to respond, so the assistant may report the change a moment after you ask. Lights can also be set to turn on or off at a time you choose; the assistant shows the schedule before it saves it.

[help-media-05] Following a podcast
Follow a podcast to be told when a new episode is released. Ask the assistant to follow a show by name. Episodes play in the order they were released, or the latest first, as you choose. The assistant can play the latest episode, or a named one. Episodes you have started are remembered, so you can resume them later. Unfollowing a show keeps its episodes you have already listened to, but removes it from future reports of new episodes.

[help-devices-04] Dimming and brightening lights
Brightness is a percentage from one, the dimmest, to one hundred, the brightest. Ask for a light to be set to a value, or ask for it to be made brighter or dimmer by a step. The assistant applies the change in steps so the light does not flicker. Lights that cannot dim report that they can only be on or off. Colour changes work the same way on lights that support colour; a light without colour support keeps its current colour and the assistant tells you so.
show me the available colors of lights

text: The available colors of lights depend on the specific light fixture, as not all lights support color changes. If your light supports color, you can ask the assistant to set it to a specific color, such as red, blue, or green. However, lights without color support will keep their current color and the assistant will inform you of this [help-devices-04].
